title: Sourcer Senior
description:
Estamos em busca de Sourcer Sênior para integrar o time de Talent Acquisition com foco em contratação LATAM e Brasil da AI/R Company , grupo que reúne empresas como Avenue Code, Invillia e Compass UOL. Você será responsável por mapear o mercado, gerar listas qualificadas e atuar em parceria com os recrutadores, garantindo uma experiência de candidato fluida e processos mais assertivos.


Você será responsável por:

  • Atuar na identificação, mapeamento e prospecção ativa de talentos para posições técnicas (Desenvolvimento, QA, DevOps, Data, etc.);
  • Utilizar estratégias avançadas de sourcing ;
  • Criar e manter pipelines de talentos atualizados e segmentados por senioridade, tecnologia e região;
  • Conduzir primeiros contatos com candidatos , apresentando a oportunidade e avaliando o fit inicial;
  • Alimentar e manter atualizadas as informações no ATS e LinkedIn Recruiter ;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o(a) Tech Recruiter e a liderança para alinhar perfis e prioridades de busca ;
  • Contribuir com relatórios de funil de recrutamento e métricas de conversão;
  • Apoiar ações de employer branding e engajamento de talentos .


O que você precisa ter:

  • Experiência prévia como Sourcer, Talent Researcher ou Recrutador com foco em tecnologia;
  • Desejável vivência com vagas de diferentes países;
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de busca e automação (LinkedIn Recruiter, AmazingHiring, SeekOut, HireEZ, etc.);
  • Experiência com buscas booleanas ;
  • Capacidade analítica e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Desejável Inglês avançado;
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal, com foco em relacionamento e abordagem personalizada.


A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. title: Engenheiro de Software Pleno PJ (Ruby on Rails)
description:
O Grupo Smart Fit é muito mais do que a maior rede de academias da América Latina e o maior empregador de profissionais de educação física do mundo. Somos um verdadeiro ecossistema focado em bem-estar e saúde, impactando a vida de milhares de pessoas todos os dias.


Estamos em mais de 15 países, com mais de 1.800 unidades, e temos o prazer de atender mais de 5,2 milhões de alunos. Nossa equipe de 15 mil colaboradores está sempre a mil, trazendo novas ideias e inovações. Desde que abrimos nossa capital em 2021, aceleramos nossa missão de transformar vidas com soluções de fitness e saúde.


Temos várias marcas no nosso portfólio, como Bio Ritmo, Smart Fit, Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, One Pilates, Velocity, Kore TotalPass e Nation CT. Além disso, oferecemos produtos digitais como Queima Diária, Smart Fit Nutri e Smart Fit Coach. Estamos sempre procurando novas formas de integrar tecnologia e inovação para ajudar você a ter um estilo de vida mais ativo e saudável. E aí, topa o desafio junto com a gente?


O que nos move todos os dias?

Somos parte da mudança, transformando o cenário e trazendo mais qualidade para a vida de quem tá junto com a gente. Cada gotinha de suor é uma prova do nosso compromisso em inspirar e motivar todo mundo que quer uma vida mais ativa e saudável. A cada dia, começamos nossa jornada com aquecimento total, prontos para alcançar novos objetivos e viver o máximo.


O Engenheiro de Software Pleno PJ (Ruby on Rails) será responsável por:

1. Desenvolvimento e Entrega Técnica

  • Construção da API Core: Desenvolver e manter endpoints RESTful eficientes utilizando Ruby on Rails para suportar as aplicações Web e Mobile.
  • Escrita de Testes Automatizados: Garantir a estabilidade do sistema através de testes de integração e unitários (RSpec), utilizando VCR e WebMock para garantir que as dependências externas não atrasem o pipeline.
  • Otimização de Performance: Garantir que a API seja rápida e escalável, aplicando boas práticas de banco de dados (PostgreSQL) e evitando gargalos de processamento.


2. Integração e Homologação (Foco em Qualidade)

  • Validação de Integração: Testar e homologar ativamente as interações da API com o desenvolvimento Front-end (Web e Mobile), garantindo que os dados trafegados estejam corretos e performáticos.
  • Garantia de Eficiência: Assegurar a máxima qualidade no processo de integração, antecipando falhas de contrato de dados e garantindo que as funcionalidades atendam aos requisitos de UI/UX de ambos os clientes.
  • Definição de Contratos: Colaborar no desenho técnico prévio dos endpoints para garantir que o time de Front-end tenha mocks funcionais e especificações claras, minimizando o retrabalho.


3. Colaboração e Alinhamento

  • Gestão de Bloqueios: Atuar de forma proativa para identificar e comunicar impedimentos técnicos que possam impactar o cronograma de 3 meses.
  • Code Review: Participar de revisões de código focadas em manter o padrão de qualidade da equipe e a consistência do \"Rails Way\".


4. Aprendizado e Melhoria Contínua

  • Evolução Profissional: Manter-se atualizado com as novas versões do Ruby e do Rails, trazendo as melhores práticas de segurança e arquitetura para o projeto a longo prazo.
  • Aprimoramento de Processos: Analisar constantemente o ciclo de desenvolvimento e propor melhorias que tornem o fluxo de deploy e a integração com o front-end mais ágeis.

title: Senior Network Implementation Engineer – Juniper/MIST
description:
Senior Network Implementation Engineer – Juniper/MIST

Remote working - report to US


NTT DATA Inc. is a multinational technology company offering services in software development, security, cloud, and especially IT infrastructure. According to Great Place to Work, we are among the best technology companies to work for in Brazil. We foster an inclusive work culture and highly value the freedom to improve processes, flexibility, and respect for people!

To achieve great things together, NTT DATA Inc. believes in and fully supports diversity. Our company is open to everyone, regardless of disability, gender, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, age, origin, or appearance.


What Will You Do?

As a Level 4 Juniper Route/Switch, WAN Edge, Wireless, and MIST Solutioning Engineer, you will:

  • Design, implement, and manage advanced network solutions focused on Juniper technologies (route/switch, WAN edge, wireless, MIST, SDWAN, SSR).
  • Lead design and delivery projects, working closely with clients to meet complex requirements.
  • Mentor and guide junior engineers, ensuring high-quality work and continuous improvement.
  • Provide architectural guidance and consulting on best practices for network design and implementation.
  • Conduct hands-on installation, configuration, and maintenance of Juniper network components.
  • Write reports, proposals, and maintain project documentation.
  • Engage with vendors for priority escalations and troubleshooting.
  • Take ownership of relevant technologies and lead by example in project execution.


What Do We Expect From You?

  • Advanced/Fluent English – daily contact with the US is required.
  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Information Technology, Computing, or related field.
  • Professional certification in Juniper technologies (JNCIE, JNCIP, etc.).
  • Knowledge of Cisco technologies and certifications (CCNP, CCIE, etc.).
  • Minimum 10 years of network engineering experience, with at least 7–10 years leading design and delivery for professional services.
  • Strong consulting, communication, and client engagement skills.
  • Ability to coach and mentor team members.
  • Extended experience in Juniper SDWAN and SSR technologies.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and report writing abilities.


What Do We Offer?

  • CLT employment contract
  • Work equipment provided
  • Meal/food vouchers
  • Home office allowance
  • Health and dental plans for you and your family
  • Group life insurance
  • Totalpass (gym partnership)
  • Maternity kit and extended paternity leave
  • Birthday day off
  • Opportunities to participate in social initiatives
  • Incentives for education and training
  • An inclusive work culture where together we achieve great things!

  • Design, implement, and manage advanced network solutions focused on Juniper technologies (route/switch, WAN edge, wireless, MIST, SDWAN, SSR).
  • Lead design and delivery projects, working closely with clients to meet complex requirements.
  • Mentor and guide junior engineers, ensuring high-quality work and continuous improvement.
  • Provide architectural guidance and consulting on best practices for network design and implementation.
  • Conduct hands-on installation, configuration, and maintenance of Juniper network components.
  • Write reports, proposals, and maintain project documentation.
  • Engage with vendors for priority escalations and troubleshooting.
  • Take ownership of relevant technologies and lead by example in project execution.


What Do We Expect From You?

  • Advanced/Fluent English – daily contact with the US is required.
  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Information Technology, Computing, or related field.
  • Professional certification in Juniper technologies (JNCIE, JNCIP, etc.).
  • Knowledge of Cisco technologies and certifications (CCNP, CCIE, etc.).
  • Minimum 10 years of network engineering experience, with at least 7–10 years leading design and delivery for professional services.
  • Strong consulting, communication, and client engagement skills.
  • Ability to coach and mentor team members.
  • Extended experience in Juniper SDWAN and SSR technologies.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and report writing abilities.


What Do We Offer?

  • CLT employment contract
  • Work equipment provided
  • Meal/food vouchers
  • Home office allowance
  • Health and dental plans for you and your family
  • Group life insurance
  • Totalpass (gym partnership)
  • Maternity kit and extended paternity leave
  • Birthday day off
  • Opportunities to participate in social initiatives
  • Incentives for education and training
  • An inclusive work culture where together we achieve great things!

title: Senior Software Engineer (LAMP / Angular / JavaScript)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of development experience solving complex technical problems across front-end, back-end, and full-stack technologies, including Angular, to join our U.S. client. The ideal candidate should have experience in server-side logic development, defining and maintaining central databases, and ensuring high performance and request responsiveness. The role will involve transforming UI / UX designs into functional HTML, CSS, and JavaScript (including Angular). The primary application stack is LAMP, comprising the latest versions of PHP, MySQL, and Linux, along with Angular for front-end development. You will also be responsible for integrating Angular components built by co-workers into the application.

Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System that integrates booking, guest communications, and financial reporting, all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities

  • Build efficient, testable, and reusable PHP or JavaScript modules
  • Identify solutions to complex problems
  • Solve performance issues and architectural challenges
  • Integrate data storage solutions like MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB
  • Ensure that the code that you produce passes the SonarCloud quality rules for each pull request
  • Integrate user-facing elements developed by front-end developers, including Angular components
  • Translate UI / UX designs and convert them into working HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, including Angular
  • Analyze, configure, and tune the front-end web application, including Angular performance optimization
  • Be a subject matter expert on web technologies, including Angular
  • Enforce software development standards and mentor junior engineers in Angular development best practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience in web application development using Angular
  • Strong knowledge of PHP web frameworks and libraries (e.g., Zend Framework, Laminas, Laravel, Symphony, and Doctrine)
  • Understanding of MVC design patterns, front-end technologies (e.g., JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and Angular), accessibility and security compliance, scalable application design principles (including Angular architecture and scalability considerations), and user authentication and authorization across multiple systems, servers, and environments
  • Familiarity with SQL and NoSQL databases and their declarative query languages
  • Proficient understanding of code versioning tools, such as Git and GitHub
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or some technical engineering
  • Familiarity with code review and analysis tools, such as SonarCloud
  • Experience with AWS
  • Knowledge of AI toolsets and toolkits


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

100% remoto e CLT


Benefícios:

Vale Refeição - Cartão Swille

title: Customer Support Representative, Level 1
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


We are seeking an experienced Customer Support Representative to be on the front lines by answering questions and troubleshooting technical problems. You will assist customers with JoVE’s products and also guide clients through any technical issue they might encounter. If you are an energetic self-starter problem solver with a basic technical background and excellent communication skills, we want to talk to you. The Support Team here at JoVE is providing support not only to external customers but also to internal JoVE employees on a 24x7 basis.



Responsibilities:


  • Manage large amounts of incoming tickets.
  • Provide support to answer inquiries on products.
  • Accept and handle technical requests.
  • Triage tickets to the correct L2 teams.
  • Follow communication procedures, guidelines and policies.
  • Provide accurate, valid and complete information by using the right methods/tools.
  • Build sustainable relationships and trust with customers through open communication.
  • Handle customer complaints, provide appropriate solutions and alternatives within the time limits; follow up to ensure resolution.
  • Keep records of customer interactions, process customer accounts and file documents.
  • Take the extra mile to engage customers.
  • Performs other specific duties or assignments as directed by Team Manager.


Skills And Qualifications:


  • A Bachelor’s in Computer Science or related field.
  • 2+ years of demonstrable experience in customer support.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, verbal and written, are required to effectively and accurately communicate in English.
  • Ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical personnel in a clear and easy fashion.
  • Basic understanding of KPIs and Metrics.
  • Attention to detail is key to this position.
  • Must be able to accommodate flexible work schedules based on business needs.
  • Must have technical/diagnostic ability along with analytical ability to diagnose problems above basics, and basic mechanical skills.
  • Understand how to use a web browser console log in the debugging process
  • Understanding of Public/Private IP addresses and Domain names
  • Understanding what a Firewall does
  • What does a Proxy Server do
  • Understanding of the basics of SSO


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

title: JDE Functional Finance Lead
description:
We’re looking for an experienced JDE Functional Finance Lead to join our team and play a key role in supporting and optimizing JD Edwards Financial processes. This role is ideal for a hands-on finance systems professional with strong functional expertise in GL, AP, Tax, and regulatory compliance .


Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and support JD Edwards (JDE) Financial modules , including GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets, and Tax
  • Partner with Finance, Tax, Audit, and IT teams to ensure accurate and compliant financial processes
  • Translate business requirements into functional system solutions
  • Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities
  • Ensure compliance with financial regulations, tax rules, and internal controls
  • Lead testing (UAT), enhancements, and system improvements
  • Provide functional guidance, training, and ongoing support to finance users
  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and automate financial processes


Required Skills and Experience:

  • Strong functional experience with JD Edwards Financials
  • Proven expertise in General Ledger, Accounts Payable, and Tax
  • Solid understanding of financial regulations and compliance
  • Experience leading or supporting JDE implementations or upgrades
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with technical and business teams
  • Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or Information Systems
  • Experience in multi-entity or multi-country financial environments
  • Prior experience as a functional lead or subject matter expert

title: Consultor ABAP/EWM
description:
Desenvolvedor ABAP/EWM (Expertise Tecnica em EWM)


Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor ABAP experiente, com forte expertise técnica em EWM p ara uma posição 100% remota - necessário inglês avançado/fluente .


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar, construir, aprimorar e dar suporte aos processos SAP EWM utilizando ABAP.
  • Desenvolver e manter menus RF , interfaces com dispositivos RF e Adobe Forms .
  • Colaborar com equipes funcionais e técnicas para garantir soluções EWM de alta qualidade.
  • Identificar, solucionar e resolver problemas técnicos complexos com postura proativa e foco em resolução.
  • Comunicar-se de forma eficaz com stakeholders em inglês.


Requisitos

  • E xperiência como Desenvolvedor ABAP Senior/Expert, com foco em desenvolvimento técnico EWM.
  • Sólida compreensão dos processos EWM e capacidade de projetá-los ou aprimorá-los.
  • Experiência em mais de uma implementação completa (full cycle).
  • Experiência prática e aprofundada em: (Desenvolvimento de RF-menu, Interfaces com dispositivos RF e Adobe Forms)
  • Forte capacidade analítica, resolução de problemas e boa comunicação.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar cobrindo principalmente o horário das 12h às 18/19h EST .
  • Inglês avaçado/fluente (falado e escrito).


Detalhes do Contrato

  • Tipo: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ)
  • Duração: Mínimo de 5 meses , com possibilidade de extensão por até 1 ano *Renovável
  • Local: Remoto - Disponibilidade imediata para inicio frente aprovação .

title: Analista de Suporte Protheus / Analista Fiscal Protheus (Suporte AMS)
description:
Analista Fiscal Protheus (Suporte AMS) – Remoto


Somente serão considerados profissionais com experiência comprovada em Suporte ao Protheus Fiscal .


Estamos em busca de um Analista de Suporte Protheus com foco em Fiscal , para atuação 100% remota , prestando sustentação e suporte funcional em ambiente corporativo.


O profissional será responsável por atender chamados, analisar incidentes, apoiar melhorias e garantir a correta operação dos processos fiscais no ERP Protheus , com forte interface com áreas contábil, fiscal e TI.



Responsabilidades


  • Sustentação e suporte funcional dos módulos fiscais do Protheus
  • Atendimento e resolução de chamados fiscais (N1/N2)
  • Análise de erros em rotinas fiscais, apuração e obrigações acessórias
  • Apoio a usuários nas rotinas fiscais e operacionais
  • Atuação em melhorias e ajustes de processos fiscais
  • Interface com áreas internas, contabilidade e consultorias externas
  • Documentação de procedimentos e soluções
  • Apoio em homologações e validações fiscais

title: SAP Fiori
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for SAP Dev BTP UI5 Fiori who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Work as part of SAP Empowered Product Teams, design, develop, and maintain BTP Fiori applications for SAP Dynamic Forms.

The ideal candidate will have 3–7 years of hands-on experience in SAP UI5 development and should be highly skilled in building responsive, scalable, and user-friendly enterprise applications.

SAP UI5 / Fiori: Strong experience in developing, customizing, and extending Fiori/UI5 applications

SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform): Hands-on experience with BTP services, particularly in application development and deployment

Frontend Development: Strong skills in JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, JSON, XML

UI/UX Design: Experience creating responsive and user-friendly applications

OData Services: Proficient in consuming and integrating OData services; knowledge of SAP Gateway

Development Tools: SAP Business Application Studio (BAS), SAP Web IDE, Git

Version Control & CI/CD: Familiar with GitHub/GitLab, Jenkins, or other CI/CD pipelines

Performance Optimization: Ability to optimize UI5 apps for performance and scalability

Experience with CAP (Cloud Application Programming) Model on SAP BTP

Exposure to Node.js, REST APIs, or microservices architecture

Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies

Understanding of security concepts (authentication, authorization in SAP BTP)

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Engenheiro de Voip
description:
Buscamos um(a) SBC Specialist para atuar remotamente em um ambiente global, com forte interação internacional e foco em soluções de telefonia corporativa e Microsoft Teams Phone.

A posição exige experiência prática com Session Border Controllers (SBC) e forte capacidade analítica para troubleshooting em ambientes críticos.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Administração, configuração e troubleshooting de Session Border Controllers (SBC), preferencialmente Audiocodes
  • Suporte e operação de ambientes de Microsoft Teams Phone
  • Atuação em incidentes complexos envolvendo telefonia e redes
  • Interface técnica com clientes, garantindo alto nível de serviço


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida com Session Border Controllers (SBC) (Audiocodes é altamente desejável)
  • Inglês avançado/fluente (comunicação diária com times globais)
  • Conhecimento em Microsoft Teams Phone
  • Forte capacidade analítica e experiência em troubleshooting
  • Conhecimento em telefonia corporativa (Cisco, Mitel, Avaya ou similares)
  • Disponibilidade para plantão 24x7


Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em protocolos de comunicação (SIP, RTP, TCP, UDP)
  • Experiência com PowerShell
  • Vivência em service desk e atendimento ao cliente
  • Alemão intermediário ou avançado

title: Consultor Salesforce Manufacturing Cloud
description:
Sobre a posição

Buscamos um(a) Consultor(a) Salesforce Manufacturing Cloud para atuar em projetos de implementação, evolução e sustentação da plataforma Salesforce, com foco em indústrias de manufatura. Esse profissional será responsável por traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções escaláveis, garantindo alinhamento entre processos comerciais, operacionais e a tecnologia Salesforce.

Responsabilidades

• Atuar como referência técnica e funcional em Salesforce Manufacturing Cloud

• Conduzir levantamento e entendimento de requisitos de negócio junto a stakeholders (Vendas, Operações, Planejamento, Financeiro)

• Desenhar e implementar soluções para:

Account-Based Forecasting

Sales Agreements

Volume Forecasting e Revenue Forecasting

Integração com Sales Cloud e outros sistemas (ERP, Data Cloud, etc.)

• Configurar e customizar objetos, flows, relatórios, dashboards e automações

• Apoiar decisões de arquitetura e boas práticas Salesforce

• Garantir qualidade das entregas, testes e documentação funcional/técnica

• Atuar no suporte a usuários-chave e na condução de treinamentos

• Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (arquitetura, desenvolvimento, dados e negócio)

Requisitos Técnicos

• Experiência comprovada com Salesforce Manufacturing Cloud

• Sólidos conhecimentos em Sales Cloud

• Experiência com:

Modelagem de dados Salesforce

Flows, validações, relatórios e dashboards

Integrações (APIs, Middleware, ERP – desejável SAP/Oracle)

• Conhecimento de processos de manufatura:

Planejamento de demanda

Forecast de vendas

Contratos comerciais e acordos de volume

• Vivência em projetos de implementação Salesforce (end-to-end)

Requisitos Desejáveis

Certificações Salesforce (ex: Administrator, Sales Cloud Consultant, Manufacturing Cloud Accredited Professional)

  • Experiência com Data Cloud ou Analytics (Tableau CRM / CRM Analytics)
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, SAFe)
  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos complexos ou projetos globais

Competências Comportamentais

  • Forte capacidade analítica e visão de negócio
  • Comunicação clara com áreas técnicas e não técnicas
  • Perfil consultivo, orientado a solução e resultados
  • Organização, autonomia e senso de responsabilidade
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com múltiplos stakeholders

Benefícios e Incentivos:

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraília

Para Saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico SulAmérica extensivo a dependentes;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição em cartão flexível Caju benefícios
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Auxílio Home-Office em cartão flexível Caju benefícios;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Sesc – extensivo a dependentes, com acesso aos serviços em todo o Brasil;
  • TotalPass.

Para o seu Desenvolvimento:

  • ília University: Universidade Corporativa com mais de 20 mil cursos disponíveis para desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional;
  • Language Academy: Escola de idiomas para ílians;
  • í-talks e Chapter: Momentos e cerimônias em que o time compartilha práticas, estudos, projetos e ideias. Nas chapters ainda se reúnem pessoas com skills similares para compartilhamento de ideias, práticas e experiências;

Gostamos de ir além no cuidado com as nossas pessoas, então dispomos também de alguns benefícios não convencionais:

  • Plano de Saúde PET - Guapeco
  • Onhappy – benefício de viagem a lazer, com liberdade para você viajar com quem quiser.

title: UX Product Designer
description:
This position is a remote position to work with US clients from Latin America Only.


We offer:

  • 100% Remote Work
  • 25 USD per hour


Title: UX Product Designer


Job Summary:

We are hiring a highly execution-oriented Product Designer to work directly with a Design Manager as their only direct report. This is a hands-on, delivery-driven role with a strong emphasis on rapid prototyping, fast iteration, and strict design system discipline.


This is not a strategy or research role. Success is defined by speed, clarity, and the ability to turn rough direction into high-quality, testable prototypes and production-ready designs.


Requirements:

  • 5+ years product design experience (post-education)
  • Advanced Figma proficiency, including interactive prototyping
  • Real product work, not concept-only projects
  • Strong design system and component library experience
  • Can iterate and deliver updates within 24 hr

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges, collaborate on an interesting product, be up to date with the latest technology, and contribute to taking our product to market? Then keep reading!


Yes, tell me more…

fullinfo is a startup B2B data services software company.

We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s.


We are currently hiring a Senior DevOps Engineer with AWS CDK knowledge for an initial 12-month B2B Contract on a remote basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (EDA architecture) and TypeScript and willing to pick up new technologies as needed.


Responsibilities:

  • Participate in our DevOps team
  • Ensure the quality of our AWS infrastructure
  • Develop and review infrastructure code that enhances performance and cost efficiency
  • Ensure seamless integration of all AWS services within our architecture
  • Optimize the infrastructure for continuous scalability
  • Drive ongoing improvements in CI/CD pipelines
  • Collaborate with development teams, the CTO, and technical leads


Requirements:

  • A Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 6 years relevant experience working in DevOps roles
  • Hands-on experience with TypeScript and AWS CDK
  • Coding experience in implementing business features
  • Familiarity with AWS services, including Lambda, API Gateway, S3, CloudFront, EventBridge, AppSync, DynamoDb, OpenSearch
  • Business-level proficiency in English


The successful candidate will…

  • Be comfortable working remotely and independently, with some overlap with HQ work schedule
  • Take ownership and be accountable for their work
  • Be eager to work on various aspects of our cloud infrastructure in a generalist role
  • Quickly familiarize themselves with our infrastructure to generate new ideas and improve our existing setup
  • Have experience supporting other teams in implementing AWS solutions
  • Adopt a proactive, hands-on approach


What can you expect from us?

  • To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward.
  • Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together?A flat hierarchical structure with room for innovation in a highly motivated team.
  • A start-up environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software.


Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:

Quality: At fullinfo we have show-and-tell energy, and we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We love building beautiful software and get hyped by always raising the bar on quality. Our product is beautiful inside and outside. How do we achieve this? By always asking ourselves “Is this right?” or “Does this make sense?”.

Problem Solving: We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

Sobre a ília

Presente em mais de 70 países e com aproximadamente 100.000 especialistas ao redor do mundo, nossa empresa está no novo ranking Digital 100 da Forbes, uma lista das principais empresas de capital aberto que moldam o mundo digital nas áreas de Tecnologia da Informação (TI), hardware, mídia, e-commerce e telecomunicações.

Abap Classico

BTP conhecimentos básicos

CDS

Workflow

SEGW/oData

title: Managing Director & Country Head: AI Data Center Infrastructure
description:
Managing Director & Country Head: AI Data Center Infrastructure

Location: Remote; travel within-country

Sector: Modular Data Center Infrastructure (AI & HPC)

Reports to: Chief Executive Officer


About MatraVolt

MatraVolt is a deep-tech company building next-generation prefabricated infrastructure for the AI era. Our multi-module architecture enables high-density, liquid-cooled deployments with radically faster delivery, lower on-site risk, and superior total cost. The solution has been adopted by the one of the world’s largest AI data center project in the United States and we are now scaling across EU and Latin America with colocation providers, hyperscale developers, EPCs, and energy-conscious AI platforms.


Role Summary

We’re hiring a Country Head at MD level to drive MatraVolt’s go-to-market and commercial outcomes. You will build and convert a country-level pipeline with colocation operators, hyperscalers, developers/EPCs, and other players in the ecosystem, form strategic partnerships, and orchestrate complex, technical deals - positioning MatraVolt as the default choice for next-gen AI/HPC infrastructure.


Key Responsibilities
  • Market development: map priority accounts (colo, hyperscale, BTS developers, EPC/SIs, utilities/energy partners), create multi-threaded entry, and land flagship wins.
  • Enterprise sales: qualify, shape requirements, lead solutioning with engineering (high-density racks, liquid cooling, modular power/cooling blocks).
  • Partnerships & routes-to-market: establish and manage EPC / SI / channel alliances and project-specific consortiums.
  • Program leadership: drive country bids/RFPs; coordinate delivery timelines and site readiness with Operations.
  • Intelligence & feedback: provide structured market signals (customer pain, regulatory/power constraints, competitive moves) to sharpen product, pricing, and delivery playbooks.
  • Governance & risk: ensure compliance with customer, HSE, and site policies.


Ideal Profile
  • 5+ years in enterprise data center / critical infrastructure sales or BD.
  • Credible network among colocation buyers and AI/HPC stakeholders; comfortable at C-suite, engineering, and procurement levels.
  • Fluency in technical value: high-density GPU environments, liquid cooling, modular power & cooling blocks, prefabrication/off-site integration, and time-to-live economics.
  • Entrepreneurial, hands-on operator who can open doors, design the deal at startup pace.
  • Languages: Native Portuguese/Spanish and Fluent English


Contract Details
  • Type: Contractor / Independent Consultant
  • Compensation: Monthly travel allowance + uncapped, highly competitive success-based commission
  • Start: Immediate


Why Join MatraVolt
  • Scale a solution already validated by the largest AI data center deployment globally.
  • Work where deep-tech, energy, and AI compute converge—on real projects, fast.
  • High autonomy, tight engineering partnership, and a product that wins on speed and cost.
  • Shape the country playbook and help define how Latin America builds AI infrastructure.

Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei #fera em desenvolvimento, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos por #feras com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • Experiência sólida com .NET em suas versões antigas e atuais.
  • Experiência com AWS e suas principais ferramentas.
  • Experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços e tecnologias de mensageria como RabbitMQ.
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais, como SQL Server e MySQL, e NoSQL como MongoDB e outros.
  • Experiência em processos de Integração Contínua e Entrega Contínua (CI/CD).
  • Conhecimento em versionamento de código utilizando Git.


- Diferenciais:

  • Certificações AWS.
  • Experiência com outras plataformas de cloud, como Azure ou GCP.
  • Conhecimento em containers, como Docker e Kubernetes.
  • Vivência com sistemas de alta disponibilidade e escalabilidade.


- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Senior Data Scientist who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

SAFe We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist with extensive experience in Python, Machine Learning, and advanced knowledge of AWS components to lead data analysis projects and develop scalable solutions. Technologies such as Deep Learning and GenAI will be considered advantages.

Experience with Deep Learning (TensorFlow, PyTorch). Knowledge in GenAI (LLMs, Prompt Engineering, APIs such as OpenAI, HuggingFace). Experience with multimodal models.

Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, or related fields.

Experience:

Advanced programming in Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn).

Development and implementation of Machine Learning models at scale.

Solid experience with AWS components (S3, Lambda, SageMaker, EC2, IAM).

Experience in technical leadership or team mentoring.

Additional skills:

Handling large volumes of data.

Knowledge of SQL and relational/non-relational databases.

Best practices in MLOps and CI/CD for models.

Lead the design, development, and implementation of Machine Learning models for complex applications.

Build robust and scalable data pipelines, ensuring quality and performance.

Define architecture and integrate solutions with AWS services (S3, Lambda, SageMaker, EC2, IAM).

Act as a technical reference, guiding teams and ensuring best practices.

Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business needs into data-driven solutions.

Document processes and promote standards for versioning, testing, and deployment.

Python, Machine Learning; components AWS

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Front-End & UI/UX Designer (Webflow + WordPress)
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yep—you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a versatile, design-driven Webflow + WordPress expert who can take a website from concept to completion.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.

Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.



What You’ll Do


  • Design and develop responsive, visually engaging websites in Webflow and WordPress .
  • Create wireframes, prototypes, and full website designs that align with user needs and client goals.
  • Translate approved designs into fully-built, functional websites using Webflow or WordPress.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to clarify requirements and ensure flawless execution.
  • Ensure all designs follow UX/UI best practices , accessibility standards, and performance guidelines.
  • Customize, refine, and optimize websites based on client feedback.
  • Stay up-to-date with digital design trends, tools, and new Webflow/WordPress capabilities.
  • Troubleshoot design-related issues and ensure smooth handoff and deployment.


What You Bring


  • 3+ years of professional experience designing AND developing websites using Webflow and WordPress .
  • A strong portfolio showcasing web design, UX/UI work, prototypes, and completed builds .
  • Proficiency in wireframing tools and design platforms (Figma, XD, Sketch, etc.).
  • Solid understanding of HTML, CSS , and responsive design principles.
  • Experience with site performance optimization and SEO-friendly design practices.
  • Ability to work effectively within a fully remote team.
  • Strong communication skills—you can articulate design decisions clearly.
  • Close attention to detail and a passion for creating elevated digital experiences.



Bonus Points


  • Experience with animations or micro-interactions in Webflow.
  • Familiarity with brand identity or graphic design.
  • Experience working in fast-paced agency settings.



Work Details


  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST , Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


If you’re someone who can dream up a beautiful interface, bring it to life, and polish it until it shines, we want to hear from you.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Engenheiro de IA (LLM)
description:
#VemPraTrinks


A Trinks é uma plataforma SaaS líder em gestão e agendamento para salões de beleza, barbearias, clínicas estéticas e estabelecimentos de bem-estar em todo o Brasil. Estamos construindo uma nova frente de produto baseada em inteligência artificial generativa , com foco em automação de atendimento e gestão do ERP.


Buscamos um profissional com perfil técnico sênior, com vivência em IA generativa e engenharia de software, para liderar o desenvolvimento de um novo produto baseado em modelos de linguagem (LLMs) , integrando inteligência artificial ao core de serviços da Trinks.


Dá uma olhada no seu papel nessa #revolução:


  • Liderar e desenvolver a criação de um sistema conversacional com IA generativa (LLM);
  • Projetar arquitetura escalável e segura com integração aos sistemas da Trinks;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os times de Produto, UX, Dados e Engenharia;
  • Implementar soluções baseadas em RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) com foco em contexto e precisão;
  • Definir boas práticas de desenvolvimento, versionamento, testes e deploy de soluções com IA;
  • Acompanhar performance, custo e segurança dos modelos em produção.


O que você precisa para o #match perfeito:


  • Experiência consolidada em engenharia de software;
  • Experiência prática com LLMs (OpenAI, Claude, Mistral, etc.);
  • Domínio de Python (e desejável experiência com C#/.NET);
  • Conhecimento em LangChain, LlamaIndex, ou similares;
  • Conhecimento de arquitetura em nuvem (preferencialmente AWS);
  • Familiaridade com sistemas assíncronos/event-driven (Kafka, SQS, etc.).


Será um diferencial se você conhecer:


  • Ter liderado ou desenvolvido projetos com IA generativa e agentes conversacionais.
  • Conhecimento em prompt engineering, embeddings, vetores e fine-tuning leve.
  • Experiência com mecanismos de controle de alucinação e segurança em LLMs.


Saca só o que OFERECEMOS:


100% Home office;

⏳ Contratação CLT (40 horas semanais);

Auxílio home office;

Vale alimentação e vale refeição no cartão flexível;

Plano de Saúde SulAmérica (custo zero para o colaborador);

Plano Odonto SulAmérica (custo zero para o colaborador);

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Teachable is a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.


Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!


What is the role?

We are looking for a senior engineer with backend experience, who will join our team mainly focused on backend development, always focusing on delivering applications for high traffic access, well-monitored and fully tested. You will be responsible for the entire development lifecycle. In our team, everyone has the opportunity to share ideas, bring new solutions, and discuss them with other well-experienced engineers.


In this role you'll:

  • Write secure, efficient, and high-quality code that adheres to best practices, such as encryption of sensitive data and input validation.
  • Develop scalable and reusable code that promotes efficient development, such as creating reusable libraries and components.
  • Identify areas for improvement in the codebase and take ownership of small-to-medium-sized systems, such as fixing bugs and optimizing performance.
  • Quickly understand documentation and utilize testing techniques, such as unit testing, integration testing, and stress testing, to ensure high-quality code.
  • Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders, such as providing regular status updates and actively seeking feedback.
  • Adapt to roadblocks and proactively resolve issues, such as debugging and troubleshooting.
  • Align work with customer value by using feedback to prioritize features.
  • Balance priorities and seek guidance when needed to make informed decisions.


What You’ll Bring:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience building production web applications in an agile, startup environment.
  • Experience migrating domains from monolithic to microservices.
  • Experience working with systems at scale utilizing microservices, AWS services
  • Interest in learning or exposure to event-based architecture
  • Team player mentality: high collaborative, documentation-focused and recognizing how to balance asynchronous communications and virtual meetings
  • A passion for solving complex technical problems in both new and legacy codebases.
  • A mindset of leaving the codebase better than how you found it.
  • Experience collaborating with multiple team members with varying experience levels to design and implement technical projects.
  • Ability to work and problem-solve independently.
  • A humble, collaborative, customer-focused, and highly curious approach to problem-solving.


Nice to have:

  • Golang experience


This is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.


Teachable encourages individuals from a broad diversity of backgrounds to apply for positions. We are an equal opportunity employer, meaning we're committed to a fair and consistent interview process. Please tell us in your application if you require an accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Teachable is a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.


Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!


What is the role?

We are looking for a senior engineer with backend experience, who will join our team mainly focused on backend development, always focusing on delivering applications for high traffic access, well-monitored and fully tested. You will be responsible for the entire development lifecycle. In our team, everyone has the opportunity to share ideas, bring new solutions, and discuss them with other well-experienced engineers.


In this role you'll:

  • Write secure, efficient, and high-quality code that adheres to best practices, such as encryption of sensitive data and input validation.
  • Develop scalable and reusable code that promotes efficient development, such as creating reusable libraries and components.
  • Identify areas for improvement in the codebase and take ownership of small-to-medium-sized systems, such as fixing bugs and optimizing performance.
  • Quickly understand documentation and utilize testing techniques, such as unit testing, integration testing, and stress testing, to ensure high-quality code.
  • Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders, such as providing regular status updates and actively seeking feedback.
  • Adapt to roadblocks and proactively resolve issues, such as debugging and troubleshooting.
  • Align work with customer value by using feedback to prioritize features.
  • Balance priorities and seek guidance when needed to make informed decisions.


What You’ll Bring:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience building production web applications in an agile, startup environment.
  • Experience migrating domains from monolithic to microservices.
  • Experience working with systems at scale utilizing microservices, AWS services
  • Interest in learning or exposure to event-based architecture
  • Team player mentality: high collaborative, documentation-focused and recognizing how to balance asynchronous communications and virtual meetings
  • A passion for solving complex technical problems in both new and legacy codebases.
  • A mindset of leaving the codebase better than how you found it.
  • Experience collaborating with multiple team members with varying experience levels to design and implement technical projects.
  • Ability to work and problem-solve independently.
  • A humble, collaborative, customer-focused, and highly curious approach to problem-solving.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Executive Assistant to the COO(Brazil-Remote)


We’re hiring an Executive Assistant to support our COO in a fast-paced, international environment. This role is ideal for someone highly organized, proactive, and comfortable working across time zones.

You’ll help manage calendars, travel coordination, meetings, communication, and executive priorities acting as a true extension of leadership.


PLEASE send your resume in ENGLISH only.


Responsibilities


  • Manage executive calendar and scheduling across Brazil, U.S., and Europe
  • Coordinate meetings (virtual and in-person) with internal and external stakeholders
  • Communicate with our travel agent to coordinate domestic and international travels
  • Manage agendas, follow-ups, and executive action items
  • Support email organization and executive communication
  • Assist with LinkedIn/social media scheduling and content organization
  • Support special projects and day-to-day executive needs


Requirements


  • Experience as an Executive Assistant , Personal Assistant , or Administrative Assistant supporting senior leaders
  • Strong calendar management and scheduling experience
  • Experience coordinating international travel and meetings
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills
  • High attention to detail and discretion
  • Must reside in the city of São Paulo-Brazil or close cities within the state


Languages


  • Fluent English (required)
  • Fluent Portuguese (required)
  • Spanish is a plus


Location & Work Model


  • Brazil-based candidates only
  • Remote


Why Apply


  • Direct exposure to executive leadership
  • Global scope and international collaboration
  • High-trust, high-impact role
  • Opportunity to grow with the company

title: 11078 - Tech Lead .NET
description:
Que tal atuar como Líder Técnico/Desenvolvedor em um dos maiores grupos de saúde do país?

Buscamos um profissional com experiência no setor da saúde para atuar na Líderança técnica, desenvolvimento, sustentação e evolução de sistemas corporativos! ✨


Responsabilidades:

Atuação integrada com time de desenvolvimento, áreas de negócio e fornecedores.

Exercício de liderança técnica, apoiando o time na definição de soluções, padrões de desenvolvimento e boas práticas.

Garantia de estabilidade, resiliência e disponibilidade dos sistemas corporativos.

Troubleshooting e resolução de incidentes críticos, atuando como ponto de referência técnica.

Desenvolvimento de novos projetos, criação de APIs, manutenção e evolução de funcionalidades existentes.

Revisão de código (code review), orientação técnica e disseminação de conhecimento para o time.

Apoio no desenho de arquiteturas, definição de soluções técnicas e melhoria contínua dos sistemas.

Participação em iniciativas de inovação tecnológica e modernização do ambiente.

title: IA Católica busca Desenvolvedor Full Stack
description:
IA Católica busca Desenvolvedor Full Stack


Localização: Remoto

Horário: Flexível, 40 horas por semana.

Contrato: PJ, prestador de serviço, sem CLT.

Remuneração Mensal: R$16.108 em Dollar (USD$3,045)

Proficiência em Inglês: Muito Importante!


Como se candidatar: Envie-nos uma Motivation Letter (sem usar AI) + Curriculum Vitae + qualquer prova de dominio da lingua inglesa. Todos os documentos em Inglês para com o título \"Candidato BR: (SEU NOME)\". Na Motivation Letter, explique por qual motivo te interessa construir uma IA Católica - se essa carta for escrita com AI vamos REJEITAR sua candidatura.


Temos 5 vagas abertas: convide seus amigos para aumentar as suas chances!


Faremos um Drug Test e Background Test (registro criminal) de acordo com as leis locais.


Visão Geral


A Longbeard está contratando um Desenvolvedor Web Full Stack com habilidades e experiência em Next.js/React e tecnologias relacionadas para auxiliar em nossos projetos de desenvolvimento web e IA, e contribuir em nossa missão de construir IA Católica .


Como Desenvolvedor Web Full Stack, você estará na vanguarda da construção, implantação e suporte de aplicações web modernas orientadas por IA, incluindo nosso conjunto principal de produtos composto por Magisterium AI, Vulgate AI, e Christendom.


Você trabalhará em estreita colaboração com nossa equipe de designers, desenvolvedores e pesquisadores para transformar conceitos em realidade. Esta função exige uma compreensão aprofundada das tecnologias de desenvolvimento web, experiência prática com IA, paixão por codificação e um compromisso com a entrega de soluções de alta qualidade e escaláveis.


Este trabalho começaria de forma freelancer , em uma localização remota de escolha do contratado, até que ambas as partes sintam que uma boa relação de trabalho foi estabelecida, após o que a possibilidade de uma posição permanente em tempo integral poderá ser discutida.


Principais Responsabilidades


  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações web usando Next.js, React e outros frameworks e bibliotecas JavaScript modernos.
  • Projetar e implementar serviços de back-end e APIs para alimentar as aplicações web.
  • Trabalhar com modelos e técnicas líderes de IA para suportar e potencializar as funcionalidades essenciais.
  • Trabalhar com PostgreSQL para armazenamento e gerenciamento de dados, garantindo a integridade e o desempenho dos dados.
  • Colaborar com designers de UI/UX para traduzir designs e wireframes em código de alta qualidade.
  • Otimizar aplicações para máxima velocidade e escalabilidade .
  • Implementar medidas de segurança e proteção de dados .
  • Participar de revisões de código (code reviews) e testes de unidade (unit testing) para garantir robustez, usabilidade e confiabilidade .
  • Manter-se atualizado com as tecnologias emergentes de web/IA e as tendências da indústria .
  • Aproveitar a IA para auxiliar de forma responsável nos desafios diários de codificação.


Habilidades/Qualificações


  • Proficiência em Inglês -> Muito Importante
  • Proficiência sólida em JavaScript , incluindo manipulação de DOM e o modelo de objeto JavaScript.
  • Experiência extensa com Next.js e React , incluindo configuração/implantação de build.
  • Sucesso demonstrado na execução de todo o ciclo de vida do projeto , desde o conceito/protótipo até a implantação.
  • Compreensão de modelos, arquitetura de IA e aplicação de ferramentas de IA em projetos.
  • Familiaridade com técnicas RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), embeddings e bancos de dados vetoriais .
  • Sólida compreensão de PostgreSQL e experiência com design e gerenciamento de bancos de dados.
  • Familiaridade com APIs RESTful .
  • Experiência com sistemas de controle de versão (preferencialmente Git).
  • Conhecimento de tecnologias front-end , como HTML5 e CSS3, bem como experiência com frameworks como TailwindCSS .
  • Compreensão de renderização do lado do servidor (server-side rendering) e seus benefícios e casos de uso.
  • Capacidade de identificar interações de usuário baseadas na web e desenvolver componentes de interface de usuário altamente responsivos .


Experiência Preferencial


a. Mais de 3 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento web full-stack, com um portfólio forte de projetos demonstrando experiência na construção de aplicações web usando Next.js .

b. Experiência prática na integração de modelos e frameworks de IA em ambientes de produção.

c. Experiência com serviços de cloud como Vercel, Cloudflare, Netlify, AWS ou Google Cloud.

d. Familiaridade com protocolos de segurança web e proteção de dados.

e. Experiência com ferramentas CI/CD para implantação e gerenciamento de aplicações.

f. Capacidade comprovada de trabalhar em um ambiente de equipe colaborativo e gerenciar múltiplos projetos simultaneamente.


Faremos um Drug Test e Background Test (registro criminal) de acordo com leis locais.

title: API / Event Gateway Engineer
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional com experiência em API e Event Gateway , que atuará no desenho, configuração e operação de soluções de gerenciamento de APIs e eventos, garantindo segurança, governança, escalabilidade e observabilidade das integrações.


Atuação para cliente sediado em Portugal


Responsabilidades

  • Configurar, administrar e evoluir soluções de API Gateway e Event Gateway ;
  • Atuar com plataformas de API Management , garantindo versionamento, políticas de segurança e controle de tráfego;
  • Implementar e manter pipelines de CI/CD para APIs e eventos;
  • Monitorar e garantir a observabilidade das plataformas, analisando métricas, logs e traces;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de desenvolvimento, arquitetura e operações.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência prática no setup e utilização de soluções de API/Event Gateway e API/Event Management , como Apigee, Kong, Gravitee ou similares;
  • Conhecimento em Git e pipelines de CI/CD , utilizando ferramentas como Argo CD, GitHub Actions ou equivalentes;
  • Experiência na utilização de plataformas de observabilidade (logs, métricas e tracing).
  • Disponibilidade para atuação remota no fuso horario de Portugal


Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Experiência com ambientes cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP);
  • Conhecimento em Kubernetes e containers;
  • Vivência com arquitetura orientada a eventos e microsserviços;
  • Conhecimento em práticas de segurança para APIs (OAuth2, OpenID Connect, rate limiting, etc.).

title: Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges and contribute to taking our product to market? Are you ready to meet and exceed ambitious targets in a rapid-paced, results-driven startup environment? Then keep reading!


Yes, tell me more…

fullinfo is a startup B2B data services software company.

We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s. AWS infrastructure is managed by applying Terraform.


We’re looking for a Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer to join on an initial 12-month B2B contract basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (Serverless architecture), Typescript and willing to pick up new technologies such as Go. A language agnostic attitude towards software engineering is considered as a pro.



Responsibilities:

  • You are responsible for the quality of our data processing pipeline
  • Creating and reviewing processes that affect speed and cost efficiency
  • Ensuring all steps in our data pipeline are integrated seamlessly
  • Optimising the product for continuous scalability
  • Delivering ongoing process improvement
  • Collaborate with frontend engineers, CTO and principle software engineer
  • Meet aggressive development timelines.
  • Own complex tasks from concept to completion, ensuring the highest standards of quality under pressure.


Requirements:

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 5 years relevant experience working in Backend Software Engineering
  • Experience using Typescript for Backend Development
  • Experience with other programming languages like Python, Java, C++
  • Business Proficiency in English is essential
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Proven ability to thrive in a high-pressure, deadline-driven environment.
  • Startup mentality – understands the dedication it takes to thrive in a startup environment.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Business-level English required.
  • A strong history of delivering high-quality, high-impact results with minimal supervision.


The successful candidate will…

  • Be comfortable working with the frontend if required
  • Have a desire to work on different features within our solution, and take a generalist role
  • Possess the ability to familiarize yourself with our product quickly to generate new ideas, reflect on our existing features and think ahead
  • Be experienced with or passionate about guiding other developers
  • Take on a proactive, hands-on approach
  • Be a proactive, results-oriented professional who excels when challenged.


What can you expect from us?

  • To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward. This means taking on significant ownership and being accountable for delivering high-impact results quickly.
  • Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together as part of our highly motivated team?
  • A startup environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software. Be prepared for a very fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly to meet market and business demands.


Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:

Quality: At fullinfo we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We are passionate about building beautiful software and always raising the bar on quality.

Problem Solving: We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
Location: San Francisco, CA - Remote (LATAM preferred)

Work Type: Full-Time


We’re partnering with a confidential, high-growth technology company in Silicon Valley that’s building AI-powered platforms. This team moves fast, cares about craftsmanship, and empowers engineers to own meaningful work for the long term.


This is a full-time, remote opportunity to join a global-first product team tackling complex problems with modern tech and a culture that values quality and speed.


✅ What You’ll Do

- Design, build, and maintain features across the stack.

- Collaborate closely with product, design, and engineering peers to ship high-quality work.

- Write clean, well-tested, well-documented code.

- Contribute to architecture decisions, technical planning, and code reviews.

- Help shape team workflows, best practices, and developer experience.


What You Bring

- 5+ years of professional experience in software development as a Full Stack Developer.

- 2+ years of professional experience as an AI/ML Engineer.

- Proficiency with Python, React, Express, MongoDB, Node or equivalent .

- Strong understanding of APIs, performance, scalability, etc..

- Clear, proactive communication and comfort working on distributed, async teams.

- A product mindset and strong sense of ownership.

- Startup or high-growth team background

- Proficiency in English

- Passion for building scalable systems and great user experiences.


What You’ll Get

- Competitive compensation in USD.

- 100% remote with flexible hours.

- Long-term, product-focused work with clear ownership.

- A smart, collaborative, globally distributed team.


If you’re excited to work with a fast-moving team building the future of AI at scale — let’s connect.

title: Software Architect .NET
description:
Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital.

Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global.

Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso?

Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:


Principais Responsabilidades:

- Pesquisar, testar e engajar a adoção e disseminação de novas tecnologias e padrões de solução;

- Colaborar no desenho e implementação de soluções estratégicas para o negócio;

- Participar no desenvolvimento de novos produtos;

- Participar no desenvolvimento de projetos de APIs;

- Definir métodos de integração entre sistemas legados e novos projetos;

- Apoiar no desenvolvimento técnico dos demais integrantes da equipe.


Habilidades Técnicas:

- Experiência sólida em arquitetura de software (Clean Architecture, Domain Driven Design, Microsserviços, Component Driven Design, etc.);

- Domínio de práticas DevOps e CI/CD, com pipelines automatizados para back, front e mobile (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Bitrise, App Center);

- Vivência com Cloud (Azure, AWS ou GCP) e provisionamento de infraestrutura como código (IaC);

- Conhecimento em desenvolvimento nativo e multiplataforma (Kotlin, Swift, Flutter, React Native) e web (React.js, Angular, Next.js);

- Experiência em .NET e desenvolvimento backend escalável, com padrões arquiteturais e mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka);

- Capacidade de aplicar padrões e boas práticas de engenharia de software (SOLID, Design Patterns, Clean Code);

- Experiência com contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes);

- Conhecimento em testes automatizados e estratégias de qualidade (unitários, instrumentados, end-to-end, testes de performance);

- Vivência com monitoramento e observabilidade de sistemas (Application Insights, Jaeger, Firebase Crashlytics, Sentry);

- Conhecimento em segurança de aplicações (OWASP, autenticação multifator, antifraude, segurança mobile/web);

- Atuação com sistemas distribuídos e integração com APIs REST/GraphQL;

- Habilidade em liderar decisões técnicas, avaliar riscos e suportar múltiplas squads em ambientes ágeis.


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso!

Gympass - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

- Habilidade em liderar decisões técnicas, avaliar riscos e suportar múltiplas squads em ambientes ágeis.


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso!

Gympass - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

title: Senior Dotnet Developer
description:
Mandatory:

  • 8+ years of Development and Production support experience
  • .NET Core 8/C#: Proven ability to read, understand, and debug code written in .NET Core 8 (or a very recent version like .NET 6/7) and C#.
  • Visual Studio Proficiency: Strong familiarity with the Visual Studio IDE for debugging, navigating, and inspecting code.
  • Advanced Observability Tools:
  • New Relic: Proven experience using New Relic APM for application monitoring and proficiency in writing complex NRQL queries.
  • CloudWatch: Expert-level skill in analyzing logs via CloudWatch Logs Insights for diagnostics.
  • Advanced Troubleshooting: Demonstrated experience in applying methodical problem-solving to complex, high-traffic applications.
  • API Testing Tools: Hands-on experience using Postman for testing APIs and simulating payloads.

Nice to Have

  • AWS Services: Familiarity with the core Amazon Web Services (AWS) infrastructure:
  • Compute: AWS Lambda and EC2
  • Data & Messaging: SQS, EventBridge, DynamoDB, and S3
  • Networking Fundamentals: Understanding of HTTP/S protocols and common request routing and integration patterns.
